lessons: A switch that changes a solver and a boundary condition at once needs a run that changes only the boundary condition before anything is attributed to the solver: here the base level carried almost all of the difference.
A budget closed by rescaling is closed by construction: check the solver's own budget before the rescale, or the test of conservation tests nothing.
